title: AWQ live evidence transport and gate consumption

binding.task: AR-0037 at the exact Coordinator revision supplied to the checker
binding.worktree_digest: sha256: followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters
binding.gate_binding: SHA-256 of task, project, worktree, and session objects in canonical JSON

evidence.single_use: IDs and evidence digests are unique and sequences are contiguous

transport.offline_rule: The fixture and checker use network not_performed, credentials not_supplied, and approval not_granted.

gate_consumption.rule: AWR may correlate and expose an AWQ decision, but cannot author, promote, or replace it.

compatibility.minor_version: a checker may accept only the declared minor version

failure_semantics.recovery: An interruption is resumable only after a matching checkpoint and a new bounded resume event; otherwise the operation remains blocked.

limitations: The model validates supplied observations and does not submit to AWQ.
A gate observation is attributed to AWQ but is not independently verified by AWR.
Passing offline checks proves structural consistency only; live transport and remote consumption remain unverified.
follow_up: AWQ must independently apply its authoritative requirements and acceptance policy.
Any enabled live adapter requires a separately approved capability, credential, network, cancellation, and human-approval gate.
Coordinator reconciliation and hosted qualification remain outside this offline AR.
